FIGURE 5-5  Human beings differ from each other in only an 
estimated 0.1% of the total sequence of nucleotides that com-
pose deoxyribonucleic acid. These variations in genetic informa-
tion are thought to be the basis for the physical and functional 
differences between individuals. (From U.S. Department of Energy, 
Human Genome Program: www.ornl.gov/hgmis.)
